 'Survivor 51' has already lost 7 castaways. These 14 are still standing.
 With past twists back in play and up to $2 million at stake, the pressure is on.
 Tom Parfitt Updated Thu, October 22, 2026 at 10:39 AM UTC 5 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The cast of Survivor 51 . (Robert Voets/CBS) Survivor has officially entered a new era after its milestone 50th season, with 16 castaways still competing for a $1 million prize — although a twist could double the winnings.
 Season 51 began with 21 players ages 24 to 49, including a Grey's Anatomy actor, a wrestler and a federal prosecutor.
 They're the first to navigate Survivor 's "Open Era," where the rules of the past are back in play. As host Jeff Probst explained during the Season 50 finale, "Anything that's ever happened on Survivor can happen again — at any time, in any order, without warning."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Open Era introduces a coin flip that could add another $1 million to the winner's prize. If the flip is lost, that additional money rolls over to the following season.
 Warning: Spoilers from Episode 5 included below.
 Seven castaways have now left the competition. During Episode 5 , a double elimination meant that both Alexis Levine (Savu) and Linnea Capobianco (Dina) were voted out.
 Levine went first after the Day 1 "helicopter alliance" of Ori, Devin and Jelly held together and voted her out 3-1.
 Capobianco's departure resulted from Maggie's extra votes forcing two ties and Kilby refusing to budge. The rest of the tribe then agreed to send her home rather than risk rocks to save her.
 Advertisement Advertisement Six women in a row have now been voted out, leaving the remaining 14 to include nine men and five women.
 Here's who's still in the running — and what the castaways have said about why they wanted to play.
 An "Thien An" Nguyen
 An "Thien An" Nguyen.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 24
 Hometown: Fort Worth, Texas
 Current residence: Fort Worth, Texas
 Occupation: Medical student
 Nguyen sees the show as a rare opportunity to experience something different from everyday life. "Very few opportunities in life let you connect to life in such a raw and authentic way," she said. "It's everything I love! New friends and the outdoors."
 Angelica "Jelly" Loblack
 Angelica "Jelly" Loblack.
 (Scott Duncan/CBS) Age: 29
 Hometown: Garland, Texas, and Midwest City, Okla.
 Current residence: Bloomington, Ind.
 Occupation: Sociology professor
 Advertisement Advertisement Loblack said Survivor has been part of her life "for as long as I can remember." She added, "I want to play and win Survivor and experience it with the loved ones who introduced it to me while they're still here."
 Brady Booker
 Brady Booker.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 27
 Hometown: La Salle, Ill.
 Current residence: Knoxville, Tenn.
 Occupation: Pro wrestler
 Booker grew up watching the show with his family and is looking forward to testing himself in a different kind of competition. "I love adventure in the outdoors. I love competition," he said. "I love being pushed to my limit to show what I am truly capable of doing."
 Carter Krull
 Carter Krull.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 24
 Hometown: Rock Rapids, Iowa
 Current residence: Sioux Falls, S.D.
 Occupation: Livestock farmer
 Advertisement Advertisement Playing Survivor has long been on Krull's bucket list. "You never know when your last day will be," he said, "so better get rollin' on the list!"
 Cristian Chavez
 Cristian Chavez.
 (Scott Duncan/CBS) Age: 26
 Hometown: Salt Lake City
 Current residence: Salt Lake City
 Occupation: Head of HR
 Competition is the big draw for Chavez. "I love competition!" he said. "I also want to test my limits in this game and be pushed past my breaking point just to experience it."
 Danny "Kilby" Kilby
 Danny "Kilby" Kilby.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 30
 Hometown: Mount Forest, Ontario, Canada
 Current residence: London, Ontario, Canada
 Occupation: Game designer
 Kilby said appearing on the show is the "biggest dream of my whole life." " Survivor has given me so much already," Kilby said, explaining that he met his girlfriend while playing a fan-made Survivor game.
 Devin Way
 Devin Way.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 33
 Hometown: Lufkin, Texas
 Current residence: Los Angeles
 Occupation: Actor
 Advertisement Advertisement "There is nothing else like this in the world," said Way, who has acted in shows including Grey's Anatomy and Queer As Folk . "It's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to play one of the best games in existence!"
 Eric Macksoud
 Eric Macksoud.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 34
 Hometown: Lincoln, R.I.
 Current residence: Windsor Locks, Conn.
 Occupation: Mental health counselor
 Macksoud's interest in people is part of what attracts him to Survivor . "As someone who loves people and learning about what makes people tick, Survivor is the ultimate celebration of the human experience," he said.
 Kristin Flickinger
 Kristin Flickinger.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 49
 Hometown: Ketchum, Idaho
 Current residence: Santa Barbara, Calif.
 Occupation: Crisis management
 Advertisement Advertisement Flickinger has been trying to get on Survivor almost since the beginning. "I have been applying for Survivor since the middle of Season 1," she said. Over the years, the show "has become the lens through which I view and navigate the world — however, dysfunctional that may be."
 Lewis Kelly
 Lewis Kelly.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 28
 Hometown: Dublin
 Current residence: Puerto Rico
 Occupation: Farmer
 Kelly said becoming a U.S. citizen helped turn his ambition to play into a reality. He described the opportunity as a chance "to really live and be an example of my American dream." His philosophy going in? "You miss 100% of the shots you don't take."
 Maggie Nestor
 Maggie Nestor.
 (Scott Duncan/CBS) Age: 40
 Hometown: Middleway, W.Va.
 Current residence: Charlestown, W.Va.
 Occupation: Farmer
 Advertisement Advertisement Nestor said she has "loved" Survivor since she was 15. "I've been watching for 25 years and waiting for this opportunity of a lifetime," she added.
 Mike Pinsky
 Mike Pinsky.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 32
 Hometown: New York City
 Current residence: New York City
 Occupation: Baseball executive
 Pinsky said, "Getting to actually live this dream for real is a one-of-one life experience, and the thrill of this type of adventure sets my heart on fire!"
 Ori Jean-Charles
 Ori Jean-Charles.
 (Scott Duncan/CBS) Age: 27
 Hometown: Spring Valley, N.Y.
 Current residence: Spring Valley, N.Y.
 Occupation: Personal trainer
 Jean-Charles's motivation centers on his family. "They sacrificed everything for me to be here today," he said, calling Survivor an opportunity "to pay that back for all they have done."
 Sharonda Cox
 Sharonda Cox.
 (Robert Voets/CBS) Age: 34
 Hometown: Pompano Beach, Fla.
 Current residence: Richmond, Ky.
 Occupation: Ob-gyn resident
 Advertisement Advertisement Cox hopes competing can also inspire "those little Black boys and girls" and people from low-income communities by showing "what we can do despite our disadvantaged beginnings." She also has a personal goal: "I also want to stop going through the motions of life and meet the new, unapologetic Sharonda."
